fixed.what: POST /api/payment/request now rejects (400, Persian error «این سفارش در وضعیت قابل پرداخت نیست») any order whose status is not 'pending_payment', before calling paymentRouter and before overwriting authority.

markOrderPaid flipped to atomic predicate UPDATE orders SET status='processing' WHERE id=? AND status='pending_payment' with .returning() row-count check; VIP earned points credited only when a row was updated.

User-cancel and admin cancel branch now flip status first via atomic UPDATE ... WHERE id=? AND status IN ('pending_payment','processing') (.returning()); restock/refund via restockItemsAndRefundPoints and point clawback run only when a row was updated; 0 rows => 400 Persian error / race-lost no-op.

Coupon usage cap replaced read-only check+increment with conditional atomic UPDATE coupons SET used_count=used_count+1 WHERE code=? AND (usage_limit IS NULL OR COALESCE(used_count,0) < usage_limit); 0 rows => order rejected with Persian cap error (transaction rolls back).
Removed req.body.refreshToken fallback on POST /auth/refresh — refresh token now read only from HttpOnly cookie; tokens still returned in JSON responses on login/register/otp/verify/refresh.
PUT /api/admin/users/:id/role destructures password out of the returning row before res.json (password hash no longer leaked).
All mutation-path cache invalidations changed from invalidate('products') to invalidate('product') — substring match now covers both 'products' list keys and 'product:<id>' detail keys.

PUT /api/users/me catches unique-constraint violation on phone (SQLITE_CONSTRAINT[_UNIQUE] / PG 23505) and returns 400 with Persian message «این شماره موبایل قبلاً ثبت شده است» instead of generic 500.
